title: Finishing Pages, step 2 — the file chooser, round 3

steps.path: A page used from your phone's browser → Open a file
steps.headline: Narrower column, or the places in a menu on a folder button at the start of the path?
steps.notice: Both now open on tiles for someone new (your note); the list is one tap away.

variants.label: Narrower column
variants.summary: The column you picked, about a fifth narrower, so six tiles fit to a row. Every place is visible at once.

variants.label: Folder menu in the path
variants.summary: A folder button starts the path (Home › Pictures); it drops a menu of Home, Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures. No column or row at all, so seven tiles fit, and a phone shows the same thing.
variants.risk: The places are one tap further away, and someone new may not guess the folder button holds them.

steps.path: The folder-menu version on a phone
steps.headline: On a phone the folder button sits at the start of the path, the same as on a computer.
steps.changed: Folder button, Home › Pictures, the list / tiles switch, search, then tiles three to a row.
steps.notice: With the column picked above, a phone uses this same menu (a column does not fit a phone).
